name: Sollunea
source:
An adventure novel set in a medieval European fantasy world. A remote village in engulfed in war flames. Village is visited by traders who say that they were attacked by female thieves who kidnapped accompanying daughter of the priest. Main character decides to rescue the girl and leaves the village.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一部以中世纪欧洲风格奇幻世界为舞台的冒险小说。偏远村庄被战火吞没。几名商人来到村中，声称自己遭到一群女盗贼袭击，同行的神父之女也被掳走。主人公决定救出女孩，离开村庄踏上旅程。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
